下载完成后继续上传（做种）是 BitTorrent 运转的基础：你能下载到的每个:
Uploading after a download finishes (seeding) is what keeps BitTorrent working: every release you can download comes from someone else's upload.

If everyone stopped as soon as they finished, releases would soon lose their sources; older and less popular shows especially become dead torrents that nobody can finish, and later viewers just keep waiting.

If you are only worried about bandwidth, lower the upload limit on this page instead of stopping completely. If P2P uploading is restricted where you live, follow the local rules.
